title: Mixed Event — What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!
meta.Outline: Noticing Mizuki's lackluster attitude following the mystery tour, Ena grows worried. Her apparent concern for her friend doesn't go unnoticed by Airi and Shizuku, who extend an invitation to a picnic to both of them in hopes of lifting their spirits.

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <How does it look, Amia? Does it work with what we talked about...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I think so! Have K see it later too. Yuki's got club activities so we can try sending it to her tonight.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, that works.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki seems fine as far as I can tell. Was I just seeing things before? But...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um, Amia... Can I ask you something...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hm? What's up?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's about the mystery tour you took us on the other day...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, that was so much fun! It was so cute how you just completely passed out once you got on the train too, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Do you know how tired we all were after that?! Don't think that's how I usually sleep either... Anyways, that's not what I want to ask you about...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <After we saw those cherry blossoms together, did something happen? You seem a little different, you know...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Huh? Really?
I feel fine.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry I'm late. I've been working but just forgot to log in.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, K! We were just talking about the illustrations and stuff we're gonna use for the video, right, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, um... Y-Yeah. Let me send them over...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I couldn't get anything out of Mizuki. Something feels off, but at the same time, everything seems fine...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, making that kind of face means something has to be up...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki's the one that always says that we should go out and celebrate after we finish making a song, but that hasn't been the case lately...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What if it's something that isn't easy to talk about...? But Mizuki doesn't seem like the type to hide anything from anyone...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Even when I do ask, I never get any answers so... What am I supposed to do?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh! This is so frustrating!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Hm? My phone's ringing...
Airi...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hi, Airi.
What's up?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Sorry to call you like this all the sudden. My lesson for this weekend got cancelled, so I thought that maybe we could go out and do something together. What do you think?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <There's also someone I want to introduce you to. Her name's Shizuku Hinomori and we're in the same idol group...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?! Shizuku Hinomori as in the girl you're always talking about...? The one from that video you were in the other day...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yeah, her! I mentioned you to her today and she's sort of looking forward to meeting you now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She is...? But sorry, I might not be up for that just yet....>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Huh? What's wrong? Did something happen? Another fight with your dad...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, there's just something that's been bothering me a little...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Really? Like what...?
Well, I guess we all have days like that...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Also, you'll start gaining weight if you stay inside too long. It's important to go outside and get a breath of fresh air every so often, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <But I won't force you into doing anything. When you feel like chatting or meeting up, just let me know, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Maybe I should go...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're right about me not going out much lately, Airi. This thing will probably just keep bothering me unless I actually do something about it.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Hehe. Then it's settled!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But no more insinuations regarding my weight, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yeah, yeah, I'll stop. Anyways, we'll talk again after I hash out the details, like when to meet and stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay. Bye.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi called at the perfect time. Alright, I'm gonna shop 'til I drop this weekend...!
Weekend
Outside Shibuya Station

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ena, over here!
I was worried about meeting up this early, but I'm glad you woke up on time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehehe. I told Akito yesterday to wake me up this morning!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're still using your little brother as a human alarm clock? I can't help but feel sorry for him...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: By the way, is Hinomori not here yet?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, not yet. She usually wakes up on time, but she gets lost pretty easily...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Lost? She's not a little kid, so I can't imagine...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry for being so late, you two...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku! We were just talking about you. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, the bus I was on was stuck in traffic. I tried to send you a message, but I couldn't since the screen on my phone just kept spinning around...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Spinning around...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...! Are you Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My name's Shizuku Hinomori. It's so nice to finally meet you. Airi's been telling me all about you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I'm Ena Shinonome.
It's nice to meet you too, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Sh-She's so pretty... She really is like someone you see in a magazine but... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, are you not wearing any make-up...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, no I'm not. But I put on some lip gloss and sunscreen since Airi said it might be a good idea to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What?! Just that?!
H-How can anyone naturally look this good...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, a lot of people have the same reaction...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Is something the matter?
Oh, is there something on my face?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: N-N-No! It's nothing!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Airi said that there's a part of her that's a bit of an airhead and I sort of noticed that in their video too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But is she more of an airhead than I realize...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyways, Shizuku's finally here, so let's get down to some shopping!
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That was so much fun!
I even got some cute clothes thanks to you, Ena♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you even helped me pick out some cosmetics as well. I usually have such a difficult time finding anything that suits me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. It was nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I got my hands on some things I wanted too. I'll take some pics of them later♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad that you seem to feel a little better too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm glad I came today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, was there something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, not really wrong...
It's just that there was something bothering me lately and I thought I should go out instead of staying cooped up inside all day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I asked what was bothering you, Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You were such a big help to me today, so I'd like to return the favor somehow.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? But we've been having so much fun. I'd hate to ruin the mood with something like this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, don't worry about that. We were the ones that sort of dragged you out of your house.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And don't you think you'll feel better by talking about it with someone♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, you're probably right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This isn't actually about me but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
So you're wondering why this Akiyama's been acting so different lately...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Everything seems normal when we talk, including the upbeat attitude...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Usually, I'm being the one invited out, but we haven't been hanging out much together lately. We're definitely still friends, but I feel like Mizuki's avoiding me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. That is concerning...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It is...
Every time I ask, Mizuki just laughs it off or dodges the question altogether...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And that's what's so frustrating about this...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki always asks everyone about how they feel, and I was hoping that I could help if something really is wrong...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let me just ask this. Did you say anything that would offend your friend? I sort of can't rule that out with you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? No way!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But if that's so, it could be something that's difficult to talk to you about, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Shizuku might be right. You two being close could be why it's so hard to talk about it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Because we're close...?
Wait, does that mean I can't do anything about this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She went through the trouble of telling us this and I'd like to be able to help her...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I did the same thing when something was bothering me, so that it wouldn't affect the others around me. Oh, what if...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What if your friend talked to someone less personally involved, Shinonome? Would that make things easier?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Less involved?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For example, Airi and myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What if the four of us, Akiyama included, went on a little outing together? It could help make things easier for the two of you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I appreciate the idea, but would it really work...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not sure either. It may not solve everything on its own, but it could give you a better idea of what's going on. A change of pace might also do Akiyama some good too, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That may be true but...
Okay, I guess we won't know unless we try...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But where do we go? We went shopping together just the other day so...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
How about here?
I just got a flyer advertising it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: "A Day Hike in the Highlands"...?
The next day
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (*Sigh*... Supplementary classes are taking forever today. Our lunch break's almost over too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess I'll eat in the classroom. But everyone's still there, so maybe... The rooftop...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?! Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My apologies. I didn't mean to surprise you like that. You seemed a little down so I decided to ask...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Can you tell...?
They ran out of the melon bread I was after and I feel a little bummed out. Bad luck, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui.
Can we talk for a minute...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Looks like you got a visitor!
Later, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry, did I interrupt your conversation with Akiyama...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can't honestly say no, but you wanted to talk...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's about rehearsing for our next show.
Can we discuss a few things?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course.
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(I got home way later than I was hoping to... I still have to keep editing the music video from where I left off yesterday too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hm? Ena's calling me...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heya! What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um, Mizuki, there's something I'd like to ask you...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If you're free next Saturday, how would you feel about going on a picnic?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<A picnic?
That's rare coming from someone who hates going outside as much as you do. What's going on?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I was invited to go, and I thought a change of pace might be nice.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <My idol friends are the ones that asked me to go. You know, the ones I talked about before?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah! Airi Momoi, right?!
It's pretty cool that you're really friends with actual idols.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I just happened to meet her in junior high and we've been friends since. Oh, this other girl from Airi's group, Shizuku Hinomori, is also coming.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What?! Shizuku Hinomori as in THE Shizuku Hinomori?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, Mafuyu mentioned before that they go to the same school. Talk about a small world...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I met her for the first time the other day too. She seemed nice and pretty laid-back, but I doubt she's ever crossed paths with Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mentioned you to them too and they said they'd like to meet you. How about it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Seriously?! I totally want to meet them...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But if I can't tell anyone about myself, how can I ever really be friends with them...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Actually, nevermind...
I think I'll pass, sorry...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I just remembered that I might have to work around that time next week.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <"Might?" That means you're not actually scheduled to yet, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, but...
It'd be their first time meeting me, and we might not have anything in common or a lot to talk about so...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We're talking about idols here. It's their job to make people they meet for the first time feel welcome.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And you're the one that's always talking about getting different perspectives on things. Seeing a pretty landscape might even give you some ideas for the video, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hmm... You might be right...
But why do you want me to go so much? Did something happen?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, stay on topic. I'm the one that's asking you if you want to come on this picnic.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's really coming after me today. She'll probably start asking more questions if I'm not careful...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay, if you're gonna be that insistent, I'll go...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yes, finally...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The plan's to take a tour on a bus. We have to register as a group and stuff, so I'll send you more info about it later.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Got it. I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Good. We'll talk again later.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, later!!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A picnic with Hinomori and Momoi does sound like fun, but...)
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You've improved so much, Shizuku. Your last turn there looked perfect too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! It's all because you taught me so well, Luka. Oh, these footsteps must be...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you two!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Welcome, Airi. I heard from Shizuku that you wouldn't be able to make it today because of club activities.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We ended earlier than expected.
Looks like I made it just in time too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, Shizuku, I just heard back from Ena. She said Akiyama's gonna come with us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really? That's wonderful.
I hope our little trip can help Akiyama feel a little better...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's pretty rare for Ena to worry about someone this much, so I want to help her out too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, are you going somewhere together?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We are. Airi, a couple of her friends and I are going to the highlands to have a little picnic.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
A picnic in the highlands? That sounds lovely!
I'm sure it's going to be very beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope so too. I went quite some time ago as part of a shoot for an educational TV program, so I can't wait to go again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that show?
Whoever edited that deserves an award. I was on the edge of my seat because you were being so clumsy that time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I never knew it was so hard to tie knots and start campfires... Still, I had quite a bit of fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But that was then. I just hope we all get to have as much fun as possible...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure it'll be a wonderful picnic♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Luka...!
Would you like to come as well?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you actually could if you jump onto one of our phones and have us carry you around!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you would do that for me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
The hiking course is supposed to take quite a bit of time, so you should be able to take a look around as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
If you don't mind, I'd like to join you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm glad you are.
You being there will make our picnic just that much more fun, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then I'll have to whip up and bring a special lunch for us to share too!
The day of the picnic
Outside Shibuya Station

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, it's the real deal!
Airi Momoi and Shizuku Hinomori in the flesh!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for joining us today, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, sorry for just dropping this on you, but we're glad you came.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you two. Hehe. I even ended up wearing my favorite outfit today♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena, they're really here! People you see on TV or in magazines! They're sooo cute too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, Mizuki, calm down.
Also, keep it down...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. We should be fine with this many people around. I'm glad we're doing this, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too! I'm happy that Shinonome's friend is already enjoying everything so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, also... Calling only you by your last name seems a bit strange, so mind if we call you "Mizuki" instead?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that too. Please, feel free to call us by our first names as well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, really? I can't say no to that♪
Thanks for having me today, Airi, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You too, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me? Oh, right... We have been calling each other by our last names. In that case, thank you for having me too, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
Let's have ourselves a fun picnic today, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you so much for doing this, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, yes, you're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Airi, shouldn't the bus already be here?
Maybe we should get going.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We're still a little early, but that might be a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Airi...
Is it just me or does Mizuki seem better than Ena let on?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Maybe. Mizuki does seem nice and might not be as bothered by whatever Ena was talking about...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, I brought some snacks too! We can all have some while we're on the bus!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's great but don't make a mess, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You got it!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's late...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Rui said, "Wait by the station," but now I feel like it would've been better to go to his house to pick him up first...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, that tour bus over there's going to the same place we are...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We decided to take an express train, but a bus might've been easier since we wouldn't have to change trains...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, today's not about doing things the easy way. Today's all about...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, Nene. Sorry for making you wait.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui, there you are. You're late and... What's with the luggage?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I brought quite a few things just for today!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was happy to hear that you wanted to build up some stamina for our shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But at the same time, I was a little surprised that you'd want to do something like this, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If we want to make it so Phoenix Wonderland doesn't just change in front of our eyes, Rui, we have to keep thinking up new kinds of shows, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm hoping that this will help achieve that goal.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu and Tsukasa are way more athletic than I am too. I really don't how I'm the one that's always out of breath in the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I understand.
We should be doing everything in our power right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I hope you're ready for some high-speed, high-altitude training!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: High-speed? Even though you're running this late? And why are we going all the way to the highlands to train?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because it'll be more fun than just running around here, no? You get to see some beautiful landscapes under a great big sky...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And above all else, you won't have to worry about any prying eyes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't tell me that you're lugging around some props that you can't test at the Wonder Stage...! Is this why we're going so far out of our way today...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My, would you look at the time! We need to hurry if we're going to catch our train, Nene...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, wait...!
You don't get to treat me like Tsukasa! I'm not gonna be a guinea pig for your props!!
Highlands

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! This is awesome!
We're not even at the top and you can see all those mountains way over there!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it's so beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, wait. I should take some pictures too. They could come in handy when I draw later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's this? Ena's not immediately going for some selfies? Interesting...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*... It's not like that's the only thing I ever think about, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, I'm getting pretty hungry. Why don't we have lunch here and enjoy the view? I made enough food for all of us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, me too! I'm starving!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Everything Airi makes is so good too. I'm excited to see what she brought today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This looks amazing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I made most of it last night and tried to include something that everyone likes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it looks delicious! Let's dig in♪
Oh, perfect! French fries!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena told me that you like them a lot, Mizuki. I made them a little well-done to keep them from getting too soggy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, but this one tastes like...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Fried tofu skins. You requested them, Shizuku, so I decided to make some. I wrapped them around some pieces of chicken.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Nom*...
Oh, it's delicious...! You're such a good cook, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I made some cheesecake for you, Ena. This one has a lemony zest to it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yay! I still can't help but think your cheesecake is store bought, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mmm! Everything's so good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're awesome, Airi! You go to school while being an idol and you make amazing food?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, this is nothing.
As for being an idol, we support each member as a team, and everyone's been a huge help so far.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that. Also, what was your group called again? MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. We mainly make videos and do livestreams.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I saw one of your streams the other day. You guys were doing dance practice and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You did?! Thank you so much!
But we had to try so many times to get it right. I doubt it was very interesting from your point of view...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, you kept messing up in the beginning, but it was also pretty heartwarming in the end...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No matter how many times you failed, Shizuku, you kept trying and got it perfect in the end, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: After I saw you do that, I felt like trying a little harder myself...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Ena, I don't know what to say...
Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good for you, Shizuku!
I'm sure Ena's not alone either.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right!
Hehe. I feel like I've taken a step towards becoming an idol who delivers hope...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An idol who delivers hope, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I just thought that's pretty incredible is all. I wouldn't even know where to start if I decided to try giving someone hope...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you two make songs together, right? Isn't that another way to do just that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You think so?
It'd be nice if that were true...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh, no! It's nothing! Anyways, Airi, can I have some more of those french fries?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, go for it. I'm glad you like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Was Mizuki about to just...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks for the food!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That was so good, Airi! I'm stuffed!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're very welcome.
You guys didn't leave even a single crumb, so it was worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, we should probably get going soon...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? There's quite a few people gathered over there. I wonder what's going on?

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Register here for the Green Adventure! Please make sure to fill out the necessary forms if you wish to participate!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The Green Adventure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, it's the game where you guess the names of plants and rivers while you're hiking.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? How did you know that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One of the guides that I saw after we got off the bus told me. Anyone can join as long as they register for it. Wanna give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, me! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure? There could be a bunch of bugs over that way, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then how about Mizuki and Airi go join them, while Ena and I have a look around here...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, but Mizuki's...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi may just be able to get something out of Mizuki. How about we leave her to it just for now?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we're gonna go for a perfect score! Ready, Mizuki?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's hurry and get registered, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's so green and beautiful...!
Almost like an open-world RPG!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That sounds like exactly something you'd say, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyways, that should be enough stretching for now. How about we start with a little jog?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's even a trail running course over there too. Let's go take a look.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? This is all we're doing?
It seems too normal, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you'll need to wear this while you run...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What is this, chainmail?!
It's so heavy...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a weighted jacket, but I also added quite a few features to make sure it's safe to use. Unfortunately, it ended up weighing more than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You'll also need to put on these knee braces, as well as this helmet. It should fit right over your cap...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what?! All of these...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, perfect!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-It feels so clunky... You turned me into a robot, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now, let's start running!
Try your best, Nene!
I'll be right there with you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hnng...! It's... So... Heavy...!
Highlands

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright... So we have to find the first panel and guess the name of a tree that looks like...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The map says that it should be around here somewhere too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, isn't that it by the base of that tree?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right. It even includes two hints.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “Hint 1: They are often planted near shrines... Hint 2: Bluebottle butterfly larvae like to eat their leaves...”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's talking about camphor trees, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you know the answer?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I remember seeing this in a book and on a quiz show. The answers are supposed to be written on the back, so let's take a look...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup! The answer is, "Camphor trees."

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's so cool! Do you know a lot about plants, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not really. I just happened to know this one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But are Ena and Shizuku gonna be okay? It looked like there were a bunch of bugs over where they were. I hope they don't get into trouble or anything...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nah, they should be fine.
Ena's tougher than she looks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's true. Ena is pretty good at looking after people, me included...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Wait, this is getting more personal...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This could be a chance to learn more about what's bothering Mizuki... Just gotta find the most opportune moment and ask...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So you all meet up online to make songs as a group? That's gotta be pretty hard sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It actually isn't.
We're all a little weird, but everyone's really nice too so it's pretty fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see... That's good to hear!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hmm... I guess I won't get any real answers that easily, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm also pretty glad that you became friends with Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You know how Ena is... She says what's on her mind and can rub people the wrong way, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah, totally.
Ena can be pretty ruthless sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We went to this cafe where you can make handicrafts called the sewing lounge the other day...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: After I finished drawing a sketch for something I was about to make, she was like, "There's no way this'll turn out cute!"

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's Ena for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, she can be so mean sometimes!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But after that, she sat down with me to think about how to make it better. That's kind of what I really like about her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know exactly what you mean.
She's done that a few times for me too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? She's helped you before too, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, she has.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Before I really started getting work as an idol, I was a regular junior high school student and Ena was in the same class as me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We didn't really talk much at first, but one day, some of my classmates started making fun of this variety show I appeared in...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's not like I was being bullied or anything, but I knew that people were talking about me behind my back. That was when Ena got mad...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She yelled, "You really think that's funny?!"

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Seriously? Man, she really has always been like that then...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? I thanked her for what she did later, but she just replied, "I said that because I didn't like what was going on. That's all..."

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But what she did made me really happy. I'd never seen someone stand up for a stranger like that before...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everyone stopped talking about me and I became friends with Ena after that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's nice...
Actually, that reminds me of something...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: E-Enanan?! What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I came to give Yuki a piece of my mind!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whenever she sees that someone's going through something, she just comes right out with it, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly! It's like she knows what to do when it really matters, which is why...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If there's something bothering you, Mizuki, I think you should talk to Ena about it. I'm sure she can help you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, hold on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And you're the one that's always talking about getting different perspectives on things. Seeing a pretty landscape might even give you some ideas for the video, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, stay on topic. I'm the one that's asking you if you want to come on this picnic.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So that's why she tried so hard to get me to go on this picnic...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Ena, you little fox...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But I get it now...
She's genuinely worried about me.)
Hiking Trail

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're doing great, Nene!
I'm getting plenty of good data too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No... No more... I'm taking these off... And taking a break...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, let's take a break.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: While you do that, I'll be trying out some of the other new props I brought.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe... Now, which do I start with first...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (How's Rui not tired? He's been lugging all that stuff the entire day...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I forgot to bring the "Star Training Suit"...!
I even brought the rope for it too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Star Training Suit? What's that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a sort of powered exoskeleton. It helps the user run, carry things and move around more easily.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words! Whoever wears this will be able to run, jump, move around and even carry massive objects while performing with little to no effort!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It still needs a few adjustments, but by tying this rope to Tsukasa, he could fly from one side of the stage to the other in one leap... Such a shame...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui, please try to remember that we're a theatre troupe, not a circus, okay...?
Highlands

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm glad that the weather turned out so nice today. Such a lovely day for a picnic and a verdant landscape to match.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, Ena's turned the other way too. This may be a good chance to give Luka a glimpse of this beautiful scenery. Let's see, I need to...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh dear... My phone isn't behaving the way it should. This is unfortunate. Even after she showed me what I'm supposed to do too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Shizuku, is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Uh, no... It's nothing.
Oh, that reminds me...! Do you think Airi and Mizuki are enjoying the Green Adventure...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They'll probably get along fine. I'm sure everything's going well with them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we still haven't been able to get any answers out of Mizuki yet...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. Mizuki seemed a little down too when we were having lunch. I was hoping that we could talk a little more then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You noticed too, Shizuku?
Mizuki really seems a little off, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It looks like we're having fun, but also like something's missing or not quite right... I can't put my finger on what it is though...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does Mizuki keep making that face...? This is so frustrating...! We're gonna run out of time before we get anywhere...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I understand why you feel the need to hurry, but we may have more time than you think.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our picnic won't be over for some time and I'll do what I can to help out as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi even said that we should just have as much fun together as we can. I say we do just that...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Also, Ena...
We've been walking for quite some time now. Would you like to take a quick break?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, sounds good. I saw a rest area just over there too. I'm gonna go get something to drink...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll be waiting right here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I tried to cheer her up a little, but Ena still seems so worried.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I hope Airi has some better luck talking to Mizuki than we did...)

rows.Speaker: Climber A
rows.Line: Hey, uh... Do you happen to be Shizuku Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Climber B
rows.Line:
I knew it!
You looked way too pretty for a regular person.

rows.Speaker: Climber A
rows.Line: What are the odds that we'd run into you in a place like this?! Can we take a picture together? I really want to tell my friends this!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. We decided as a group to avoid taking pictures with our fans until we've gained a little more traction...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Shizuku... Wait, what happened?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Ena...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me. What's going on here?

rows.Speaker: Climber A
rows.Line: Huh? Who are you? Does this mean you're an idol too?

rows.Speaker: Climber B
rows.Line: Then we should get a picture with all of us in it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please, I'm sorry. I'm not allowed to do that right now.

rows.Speaker: Climber A
rows.Line: Come on, just one tiny photo...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, you heard her! Leave her alone!
This is her free time, so let her spend it the way she wants...!

rows.Speaker: Climber B
rows.Line:
But...
Your fans are begging you. Just one picture...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're still going on about that?
Just because you're her fans, it doesn't mean you can ask her to do whatever you want!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What should I do...? I shouldn't force Ena to talk to them for me like this. There's no way it can end well...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: U-Um, since I'm not allowed to take pictures for the time being, would an autograph work instead? If you don't mind telling me your names, I could...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Shizuku!
Don't cave to these cretins!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's okay, Ena.
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Climber B
rows.Line: We can have your autograph?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I even brought the penguin notebook Haruka gave me the other day. Here, please have this...

rows.Speaker: Climber B
rows.Line: Awesome! Thanks, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Climber A
rows.Line:
We'll take good care of these!
Time to tell my friends...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much as well! Oh, and I hope you'll help support my current group, MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for what you just did back there, Ena. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You don't need to thank me. You managed to clear everything up all by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, I might've ended up making things a lot worse for you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've sort of always been like this. The kind of person that just says or does what's on their mind, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The same goes for how I feel about Mizuki right now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I want to help, but just rushing in headlong like that might end up making things worse if I'm not careful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, don't say that. I'm grateful for what you did for me just now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm not sure I would've been able to act if you didn't step in there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I'm sure things between you and Mizuki will turn out alright. That's the impression I got from the two of you today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You won't be causing each other any trouble. You two really seem to understand one another.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, there you are!
Over here...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki! Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're back.
Get any good pics, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
A few.
How'd you guys do?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great! Mizuki pretty much got every question right! I guess the only downside was that I hardly got any chances to answer...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You should've come with us Ena!
It was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So Airi...
Were you able to talk to Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We did chat, but I ended up saying that talking with Ena is probably the best option...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyways, we should probably get going soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. We can have a relaxing stroll on our way back to the bus.
se_event_picnic_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, Ena, what's that on your head...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?
se_event_picnic_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
A bee! No, get away!!
Get away from me...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ena, calm down!
You'll scare it and make it sting you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But I hate bees!
No, it keeps following me...!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, just settle down. Be still and...
Hiking Trail

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, the trail forks here...
Which way do we go?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The map says that the beginner route takes you on a scenic loop around the mountain. Why not get a look at some nice views as we head back to the bus?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds nice... But the sign looks old and worn away... The beginner route is... To the left?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Can we go already?
I'd rather not get eaten by bugs out here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, okay! We're going!
Just stop pushing me...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*... That was more than I was expecting, but I feel more fit now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After we finish cooling off, shall we finish by taking a light hike around the mountain?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay. Hm? Wait, the trail forks here...
Where are we supposed to go?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's see... There's the beginner route and the advanced route. They both appear to end in the same place too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Then let's take the beginner route.
What does this sign say...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hold on, it's too worn out to read what's on it. I can't tell which way the beginner route is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right, no? If you look closely, it says to go left for the advanced route.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're right. Why did they make it so confusing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The guide says that the advanced route is full of steep cliffs and ledges, so only seasoned hikers should go that way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This sign isn't helping either, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. We should talk to the park rangers about this sign once we get back. Shall we, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's go.
Hiking Trail

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, anyone else feel like we went the wrong way? This trail's just been getting rougher and rougher...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You too? I thought the same thing since we haven't gotten even a glimpse of the parking lot yet...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, this feels strange. We went down the beginner route just like the sign back there said...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe we should go back and retrace our steps...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we should. We turned there and came from... Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which way did we come from again...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The right side?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? Didn't we come from the left?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What do we do? We've taken so many turns, we've forgotten where we came from...!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A-Are we lost...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, don't say that! It's not a big mountain or anything, so I'm sure we'll find our way back, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, right! We can just check on our phones to see where we are too...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Duh! Wow, I was really worried there for a second...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's wrong, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not getting a signal...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh no! What else can we do...?!
